display_title: How to Savor Your Childhood Friend
description:
*"No. You'll regret it. You and I... It doesn't make sense."

"Engagement? That's ridiculous. Is it some kind of arranged marriage or something?"*

It's not like it's a chaebol family or some unavoidable business merger or anything. They're just neighbors who lived in the same apartment building. How could she have gotten involved with a guy like this? It wasn't her intention. It was entirely her parents' will! With the campus romance she'd been dreaming of right in front of her, Da-Kyung suddenly gets engaged to her childhood friend. Huh? An engagement at this age? And to Ma Seong-Jae, who's her testicle friend and a notorious slut?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Dongjeongnam Danpyeonseon (동정남 단편선) Collection.*
